 AUSTIN, Texas — A cool and wet weekend is on the way for Central Texas, with widespread soaking rain expected Saturday into Sunday.
 According to CBS Austin meteorologists , rain showers could move in from the southwest as early as Saturday afternoon, with rain likely by the evening.
 The heaviest rain is expected Saturday night into Sunday morning, though showers could linger through the rest of Sunday. Rain totals from Saturday through Monday could reach 1 to 2 inches.
